cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: A private covered gallery with latticework looking onto a dock — She sits to enjoy the orange candies she made as a gift; An open-sided boat landing where a small ferry waits under the long roof — Lu Ji takes a break from her journey and shares the citrus she brought; a restored wooden plank road bolted to a sheer cliff in Sichuan — carries her keepsake low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — seated sideways on a stool or bench; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — types a message on a smartphone with both thumbs; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — holds a wedge of watermelon out toward the camera; the upper balcony of a wooden pavilion with upturned eaves — lying on her front; A passenger terminal’s private rehearsal room with a curved viewport — A dawn departure celebration is about to start; a fashion runway under white spotlights — lying on her front; her crew cabin aboard a starship — holds a cup at chest height; her bedroom — seated sideways on a stool or bench; the Changban Bridge memorial — standing at a waist-high railing or sill; a retro-futurist home of rounded chrome appliances and soft panels — holds her keepsake up beside her face
